text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Race day. In the stands, Daiwa Scarlet, 
who is close to her debut, came to watch 
the race alongside Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere surrounding this Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup feels different from 
before, and both of them sense that 
something is about to happen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, just before the race, Sweep 
Tosho and Kawakami Princess passionately 
clashed with their strong feelings for one 
another.
